The proposer's own confidence is 0.20, and their argument concedes the document 'states no claims about React, no claims about AI agents, and no claims about teaching, estimation, sequencing, scope, or personal organization,' with novelty=0.00 and relevance≈0.33. The central interpretive move — reading the fragment as pointing to Dan Abramov's react.dev essay — is an appeal to the proposer's memory ('as I recall'), not to any content in the document; this is testimony dressed as evidence, and it is unfalsifiable from the artifact at hand.
